items.title: Deepseek V4.1 Flash 1017 在代理任務中擊敗了更大的競爭對手，同時再次大幅降低了每個任務的成本 / Deepseek V4.1 Flash 1017 beats larger rivals in agentic tasks while once again massively cutting per-task costs

sources.summary: Deepseek has released V4.1-Flash-1017 as an open-weight model that posts better benchmarks, finishes tasks faster, and produces shorter outputs than its predecessor. The company is also opening up its internal search engine through new Search and Fetch APIs at $0.75 per 1,000 calls. API users in tools like Claude Code and Codex get free access for now. The article Deepseek V4.1 Flash 1017 beats larger rivals in agentic tasks while once again massively cutting per-task costs appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: Deepseek 已發布 V4.1-Flash-1017 作為開放權重模型，其基準測試表現更佳、任務執行速度更快，且產生的輸出比前一代更短。該公司還透過全新的 Search 和 Fetch API 開放其內部搜尋引擎，價格為每 1,000 次呼叫 0.75 美元。在 Claude Code 和 Codex 等工具中的 API 用戶目前可享有免費存取。〈Deepseek V4.1 Flash 1017 beats larger rivals in agentic tasks while once again massively cutting per-task costs〉一文最先出現在 The Decoder。
